title: Gateway protocol compatibility
description: Aligns executable patch-pack semantics with gateway protocol v2.

acceptance: AC-001: Every ready executable patch pack requires regular non-symlink UTF-8 AGENT_HANDOFF.md with all canonical Markdown headings.
AC-002: Handoff workflow, target, base, patch, and evidence identity exactly match manifest.json.
AC-003: AGENT_PROMPT.md is absent by default and is accepted for one release only when byte-identical to AGENT_HANDOFF.md.
AC-004: validate-patch-pack.py preserves human text mode and adds deterministic --format json output with schema version 1.
AC-005: Invalid packs return non-zero with stable error codes and no partial success.
AC-006: Strict JSON decoding rejects duplicate keys, unknown manifest fields, and gateway-owned transport fields.
AC-007: Required headings are parsed as separate Markdown headings and handoff size, encoding, NUL, empty, symlink, and identity defects fail closed.
AC-008: Only targeted unresolved placeholder forms fail.
AC-009: Shell redirection, comparisons, angle brackets, and XML fragments do not fail merely because of their punctuation.
AC-010: Delivery validation supports manual-download, gateway-task-bundle, prompt-only, and no-action modes.
AC-011: Manual mode retains archive and sidecar naming while gateway mode uses a transport-neutral AGENT_HANDOFF.md sentence.
AC-012: Three bundled planner tools are byte-identical and start successfully with --help.
AC-013: Prepare mode accepts exactly the two generated evidence files as untracked or staged additions only under the exact evidence directory.
AC-014: Prepare mode rejects third paths, wrong directories, non-identical manifests, invalid proofs, gates, and deviations.
AC-015: Committed mode requires a direct-child evidence-only commit changing exactly the two canonical paths.
AC-016: JSON is canonical machine data, Markdown is canonical human and agent instruction data, and YAML is not accepted as wire input.
AC-017: Planner and gateway ownership are documented without implementing task-bundle, bus, routing, execution-mode, Airelay, or result transport in the planner.
AC-018: Planner manifests remain free of gateway transport-only fields.
AC-019: The canonical template and generator create AGENT_HANDOFF.md, copy all three exact tools, and distinguish template state from ready state.
AC-020: The gateway-compatible reference fixture passes semantic text, semantic JSON, manual delivery, and gateway delivery validation.
AC-021: Regression coverage implements the approved forty-case compatibility matrix.
AC-022: VERSION and workflow documentation advance to 1.3.0 as an owner-approved public-contract minor release.
AC-023: CHANGELOG and release documentation describe the compatibility and deprecation window.
AC-024: No tag or release is created before evidence, GPT delta review, merge, and exact merged-main CI.

gpt_static_checks_performed: Audited planner main at 723a8f2a10b9413dadedaf225ad9921eca6b0d4b and gateway protocol-v2 public contracts.
Authored complete validator, delivery, evidence, template, schema, documentation, fixture, and regression-test changes.
Parsed every authored Python and JSON artifact and verified exact patch operation scope.
Executed dependency-free semantic and delivery artifact validators against the authored reference fixture in text and JSON modes.
Verified the outer binary patch contains no broad placeholder false positives and is parseable by git apply --numstat.
gpt_runtime_checks_not_performed: Repository unit and integration tests were not executed by GPT.
Project compile, shell quality gates, release checks, and GitHub Actions were not executed by GPT.
No merge, tag, release, gateway task publication, Airelay dispatch, or rceman/typer operation was performed by GPT.
known_integration_risks: The committed reference fixture cannot self-pin the commit that contains itself; it is a local semantic fixture pinned to the prior immutable planner baseline. Real post-release packs must pin the published v1.3.0 commit.
The outer execution pack is validated by v1.2.0 and therefore contains a byte-identical deprecated AGENT_PROMPT.md alias; the implementation removes that alias from the canonical template.
forbidden_deviations: Do not modify rceman/gpt-github-gateway or rceman/typer.
Do not implement taskbundle transport, bus routing, gateway identity, execution mode, Airelay sessions, or result publication in the planner.
Do not weaken strict JSON, handoff identity, placeholder, scope, evidence, bundled-tool, or delivery validation.
Do not remove the two-commit implementation/evidence history or combine evidence into implementation.
Do not merge, tag, release, rebase, squash, amend, reset, force-push, or rewrite history.
